column4: toy tray on a sand table, teal rubber floor with grid, glossy coral/amber/ivory marbles, brass clamps with coral (up) or teal (down) knobs, dark catcher with pale rim, soft shadows
the grid lines bend over every bump; the spring overshoot is anchor_damping in config.js, stepped in app/src/sim/world.ts
no game's look or rules used; nearest game and the difference written down
marble, both clamp states, catcher, wall and peg each drawn in 3D or SVG; no emoji in the code
fixed tilted camera; the whole tray fits under the HUD in portrait (and in the 1280x720 play.png)
height = base + bumps + clamp height x (1-d^2/r^2)^2; clamps move on a damped spring; fixed 1/120 s step; tests/rules.test.ts
70 marbles mid-avalanche around walls and pegs; collisions and rest in world.ts; tests cover no-overlap and staying in the tray
counter 9 / 9 and '1 tap left' with pips on screen during play
a pale ring on the floor shows each clamp's reach before a tap; Session.canTap refuses taps while moving (tests/rules.test.ts)
five JSON levels, each with a solution the tests replay; npm run solve proves each by exhaustive search
three-star results card with Next level and Replay; out-of-taps card in portrait-over.png; pause card in main.ts
sound is built (clicks, floor, catch, win, lose, mute) but no check can hear it
four clamps with rings, three holding marbles in dips, one raised as a gate
slope acceleration, rolling friction, drag, marble/wall/peg/clamp collisions; 41 tests pass
target, tap limit, win at target, loss at rest with no taps, exact reset; tests/rules.test.ts
levels are data; the solver searches every tap sequence; tests fail if a level cannot be cleared at par
best stars and furthest level kept in localStorage (the check saw flexfall.progress.v1 saved); tests/progress.test.ts
ads, store, analytics and skins behind interfaces with do-nothing stand-ins; Session.grantMoves is the extra-taps hook; no SDK
marbles rest in dips around their clamp, ring visible, chevron bobbing; level 1 is the same with one clamp (play.png after the tap)
after one tap the dip is a hill, marbles are in and around the catcher and the counter reads 9 / 9
level 1 cleared 6.6 s after the tap in the scripted run; one hint line, no tutorial
the wrong clamp in level 2 ends in 'Out of taps' with Try again; tests assert clamp 0 wins and clamp 1 loses
the clamp straight behind the marbles sends them into the cup, 0 caught; the side clamp clears (tests/levels.test.ts)
level 5: neither tap alone clears, the two together do; level 4 needs all four clamps and some orders need a fifth tap
a loss offers Try again at once; R restarts at any time
about later levels: nothing to check in this build
a mark on the paragraph, not a sentence of its own
